features.justification: The .50-13 designation identifies 1/2-13 UNC; its standard 27/64-inch tap drill is 0.421875 inch. Model the nominal blind tapped extent D024 with a flat bottom; no additional unspecified pilot overdepth or thread class is invented.

features.rationale: Complete the four tapped mounting holes on the dimensioned rectangular array.
Lower deep upper-face hydraulic port, intersecting the transverse passage.
features.justification: Blind drill depth is modeled to full diameter with a flat bottom under standard drafting convention (ASME Y14.5); the depicted drill point is cosmetic.

notes: Material: CRS. Drawing units are interpreted as inches.
Printed dimension chains give .37 right and lower corner-hole margins; do not replace these with an assumed .38.
Blind drills have flat full-diameter bottoms with cosmetic points omitted. Intersecting blind passages retain their exact printed depths.

Threads are cosmetic. Additional pilot overdepth and thread class for the .50-13 holes are unspecified. NPT tapping engagement must be established for manufacture; the 2.1 drilled depth is not a thread-depth specification.
Bottom counterbores retain nominal D036 and D037, with explicit tolerances ±.001 and +.000/-.003 respectively.
G markings provide no numerical surface-finish requirement. No unspecified chamfers, fillets, or edge breaks are added.
